definitions: A person or group of people standing outside a place of work or other venue as a protest or to deter others from entering during a strike.
A pointed stake or post, especially one used in a fence or as a marker.
A small detachment of troops or ships stationed to guard an area or camp.
examples: The striking workers formed a picket line.
He hammered a picket into the ground to mark the boundary.
The picket was attacked by enemy forces.
